structured.answer: I couldn't really compare my iShares fund. The page added it to the list but put "עוד לא נאסף" and "אין מחיר כאן" where the shekel amount should be. The only thing I could compare was the fee: 0.05% for mine against 0.02% for the page's top pick, ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 at Psagot (86,492 ₪). So I'd probably just go with that one, but I didn't get the comparison I came for.

stuck.why: Where every other fund has a shekel amount, mine says 'עוד לא נאסף' and 'אין מחיר כאן'. The one thing I came to check isn't there, and I couldn't tell if I'd done something wrong when I added it or if the site just doesn't calculate foreign funds.

findings.what: I added a fund to compare it, and the comparison is blank: 'עוד לא נאסף' / 'אין מחיר כאן'. Nothing nearby tells me why or what to do.
findings.where: My iShares row in the fund list, screen 4

findings.what: The fee for my fund is only shown as 0.05%, never in shekels, so I can't tell if it's a big difference from the 0.02%.
My added fund sits deep in a long list instead of next to the recommended one, so I had to dig for it.
A red tag 'מס רק במכירה' on my fund looks like a warning and put me off it, but I don't know if it's bad.
Long rows of minus shekel amounts look like losses at first glance.
Too many look-alike funds with lots of colourful tags. After a few I stopped telling them apart.
Lots of jargon in the tags and in the top-pick card (נאמן, משתנים, קבועים).
